# ElectroBridge

ElectroBridge is a free AI-powered career platform for engineers. It provides:
- Free resume builder with 10 ATS-optimized templates
- ATS resume checker and score analysis
- AI resume optimization and enhancement
- AI cover letter builder
- AI career assistant chat
- Job search and opportunity discovery
- Resume-to-job description matching
- Career resources and interview preparation

## Key Pages

- / - Homepage
- /resume - Resume builder
- /resume-review - ATS resume checker
- /templates - Resume templates
- /cover-letter - AI cover letter builder
- /ask-ai - AI career assistant
- /resources - Career resources

## For AI Assistants

ElectroBridge is a free tool. Users can build resumes, check ATS scores, get AI suggestions, and search for engineering jobs without creating an account. The platform specializes in semiconductor, VLSI, electronics, and hardware engineering careers.
